question: Each of Z, X, C, V, B, N and M has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Only B has an exam before Z. Z has an exam immediately before X. No one has an exam after V. N has an exam on one of the days after M and on one of the days before C. How many people have exams after M?
solution:
Each of Z, X, C, V, B, N and M has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1. Only B has an exam before Z. 

2. Z has an exam immediately before X. 

3. No one has an exam after V.

4. N has an exam on one of the days after M and on one of the days before C.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 2**”.
